// note: phase.json is the source of truth the transition guard READS. The agent writes entries; the guard refuses to advance unless the entry validates. Nothing here is narrated by the agent — every hash is computed by a tool from on-disk bytes.

invariants.// note: These cannot be disabled by craft.yml. craft.yml may only tune severity thresholds and which OPTIONAL detectors run.

authorized_exit_by.// note: human approval is itself an artifact — exit is blocked until it exists

consumed.// note: GUARD: this MUST equal intent.produced[].sha256. If intent.md changed after spec ran, the hashes diverge and spec is marked STALE — this is the provenance check that closes the 'apply before/around an unapproved spec' leak.
GUARD: must equal spec.produced tasks.md hash. Catches a tasks.md hand-edited after spec sign-off.

produced.// note: the diff hash is the SUBJECT every downstream verdict must bind to. Computed by `git diff` piped to sha256 — never asserted by the agent.

gate-code.// note: 1.3 makes this MANDATORY. The guard will not let finish run without a gate-code entry whose verdict.bound_diff_sha256 == apply.produced.diff_sha256.

produced.// note: bound_diff_sha256 is the whole point. A PASS bound to an old diff cannot authorize finishing a new one — closes skipped-gate AND stale-verdict together.

evidence_bound.// note: verdict embeds (or hashes) its evidence so it can't be claimed without a captured test run

finish.// note: GUARD at finish entry: (1) gate-code.produced.verdict resolves to PASS, (2) verdict.bound_diff_sha256 == current `git diff` sha256, (3) verify.status == complete. All three or BLOCK.
